belief: I can grow something grateful in my heart each day.
title: Lotus Gratitude Growth Wheel
subtitle: Spin the wheel and name what helps your gratitude grow.

steps: Colour each lotus petal and the gratitude window.
Cut the outer circle and the pointer.
Ask an adult to help you make the centre hole.
Spin the wheel and say one gratitude thought each time it stops.
content.take_it_today: Spin once tonight and thank one person, place, or gift from your day.

prompts: A place that makes me feel safe
A way I can give thanks

wisdom.statement: Like a lotus, gratitude can grow even when life feels muddy.
wisdom.today: Say one fresh thank-you after you spin the wheel.
